releases.notes:
### Changelog
- HUD: Added image feature
- HUD: Added loading & baking count indicator
- 3D: Added model culling option
- 3D: Fixed model appearing in low quality when the Y align value is large
- 3D: Fixed tiles loading slow
- 3D: Render distance is now infinite when it reaches its maximum value
- For those who use Google Earth, please add the following configuration:
```yml
hud_image: https://i.imgur.com/pCnsj6x.png
copyright:
  en_us: [{"text":"Google Terms of Service","color":"aqua","underlined":true,"clickEvent":{"action":"open_url","value":"http://www.google.com/intl/en/policies/terms"}},{"text":"\n\n","color":"white"},{"text":"Google Privacy Policy","color":"aqua","underlined":true,"clickEvent":{"action":"open_url","value":"http://www.google.com/policies/privacy"}}]
```
